title: Hide And Seek
paragraphs: “That being said, they’ve played with the local kids in towns we’ve stayed in before. They probably just found some playmates and wandered off a little.”

That’s true. I think so too. Yuki-chan and the other Filolials love having fun. They can easily get along with children. Especially Sakura-chan and Kou—they make friends right away. Well, in Kou’s case, given the whole incident with Mole, there might’ve been a time when he saw kids as food, though.
“No need to worry. This is exactly why the monster crests exist.”
I call up the monster crest that appears in my vision. Looks like Yuki-chan and the others haven’t gone too far.
“They’re within range. If you’re worried, I can go bring them back.”
“Yeah, we should probably go look for them, just in case.”
“Hmm… Maybe we’re being overly cautious, but…”
“So far, nothing strange has happened… If Motoyasu-kun and I go, we should find them quickly, right?”
“What about us?”
“Stay with the carriage. Keep an eye out in case anything happens.”
“Well, even if those guys attack, Ren and Itsuki could easily take them down now.”
At this point, Ren and Itsuki are strong enough. Even if they were ambushed, they could turn the tables on their attackers.
“U-um… I’ll go too.”
Mole timidly raises its hand.
“Gaelion wants to come too!”

Assistant looks reluctant but nods at Rival’s suggestion. What’s gotten into him? I can’t think of a reason why Rival would want to tag along… Wait… Could it be that he’s planning to use this as an excuse to make it seem like they caused trouble just by wandering off? I won’t let that happen!
“Alright, then let’s go pick up Sakura-chan and the others with this team.”
We each step out of the carriage and head off to search for the Filolials. From what I can see on the crest, they haven’t gone too far.
“This way.”
Father has Sakura-chan registered. As long as we’re headed in the same direction, it should be fine. Just as I was thinking that…
“This way.”
“Huh?”
The direction indicated by the monster crest for Yuki-chan and the others… And the direction Father pointed toward…
Were different. In other words, Yuki-chan and Kou are in one place, while Sakura-chan is somewhere else.
“We’ve hit a problem right away, huh?”
“Should Gaelion fly up and search?”
“I don’t think it’s necessary… but that’s an option too. Motoyasu-kun, are Yuki-chan and the others together?”
I used the monster crest to pinpoint the exact coordinates of Yuki-chan and Kou in response to Father’s question.
“They’re a little separated.”
“Then…”
Father is trying to assign teams for splitting up. However, Rival and Mole are sticking close to Father.
What does that reaction mean?
Sigh… “Alright, I got it. Then, Motoyasu-kun, once you find Yuki-chan and Kou, let’s meet up here. If I’m late, there might be trouble with Sakura-chan, so it’d help if you could search for her.”
“Understood!”

I parted ways with Father and started looking for Yuki-chan and the others. It seems Yuki-chan and the others were planning to play hide-and-seek in the large courtyard of the castle. The courtyard of Faubrey is like a maze. I noticed green arches and various pruned plants. There are also flower beds, and it’s quite beautiful—truly a castle courtyard. I found Kou hiding in a bush.
“Kou, what are you doing?”
“Ah, Kitamura! Uhm… playing hide-and-seek!”
Kou popped his head out of the bush and cheerfully answered.
“Is that so? But you shouldn’t wander off on your own. This place is a bit dangerous.”
“Huh? Kou told Kitamura he was going for a little walk!”
Now that I think about it, Kou had said he wanted to go for a walk when he stuck his head out of the carriage. I didn’t notice since I was focused on drawing Filo-tan. That was careless of me.
“Amaki and Kawasumi were sleeping, and Iwatani said I should be quiet.”
Oh no, Father’s well-meaning instructions have backfired. I must have given an empty response while I was absorbed in drawing Filo-tan. I need to reflect on that.
“Right, I’ve made a mistake.”
“Did you come to pick me up?”
“Not yet. But Father and the others were worried that Kou and the others went off, so I came to find you.”
“Ah, I see…”
“Did something happen?”
“Well… Mei and I were playing hide-and-seek.”
Who is Mei? Probably a new friend, I imagine. But Kou is the type to call people by their last name…
“Who is Mei? Can you tell me their name?”
“Uhm… I don’t really know. Mei was with Sakura.”
Hmm, perhaps Kou didn’t catch Mei’s name. Since Kou is getting along with Sakura-chan and the others, I’ll be sure to thank Mei later.
“Sakura was ‘it,’ so Kou and the others hid, but she still hasn’t come yet!”
“Oh… I hate to interrupt your game, but I need you to come with me for now.”
“Okay! But later, explain it to Sakura, Yuki, and Mei, okay?”
“Of course!”

I took Kou and headed toward Yuki-chan. It seemed Yuki-chan had skillfully gathered fallen leaves and dug a hole to hide herself by sinking into the ground. It was a game of hide-and-seek, but quite an elaborate one. However… her beautiful white feathers and clothes were completely ruined.
“Oh? Motoyasu-sama, what brings you here? Kou as well?”
“I need you to pause the game for now. Everyone is worried about you.”
“Oh my, what a shame. I was planning to surprise Sakura with my flawless and elegant hiding technique.”
“You should do something more refined—like imitating a waterfowl playing in the fountain!”
I pointed to a nearby fountain, then gracefully stepped into it and struck a ballerina-like pose, twirling in the water.
“As expected of Motoyasu-sama! Such elegance! I’m so moved that I cannot hold back my tears! I see, imitating a waterfowl!”
Yuki-chan transformed into her Filolial form and began mimicking a waterfowl. This should help wash off some of the dirt.
“Wow! That looks fun! Kou wants to join too!”
“Of course!”

For a while, we competed in elegance at the fountain. Our clothes got completely soaked. A truly splendid sight—both Yuki-chan, the magnificent Filolial, and myself, drenched in water. Just as we were enjoying ourselves, a loud explosion echoed in the distance.
Hmm!? This is an emergency. The sound came from the direction Father had pointed to earlier.
“Yuki-chan, everyone! Let’s go!”
“Yes!”
“Onward!”

Moving in perfect sync, we leaped out of the fountain and rushed toward the explosion. As we arrived, I saw Father tending to Sakura-chan in her Filolial form. Sakura-chan lay collapsed on the ground, completely limp. Beside her… was Fiancé, her face pale, tears streaming down as she spoke to her in concern.
“Motoyasu-kun! You’re just in time! Can you help me treat Sakura-chan? My healing magic and medicine aren’t strong enough…”

Rival, Assistant, and Mole were glaring off into the distance with unpleasant expressions. But now is not the time for that. Who did this…? I will hunt them down and make them pay in blood. For now, though, treating Sakura-chan takes priority.
“Oh, it’s Mei! What happened to Sakura?”
“Ugh… it hurts…”

Sakura-chan groaned in pain, so I rushed to her side and cast healing magic. A high-tier healing spell should heal her wounds quickly. However… her injuries are quite deep. Blood is dripping all around. For a Filolial of Sakura-chan’s caliber to suffer such wounds… the culprit must be a formidable opponent.
“U-um… I-I’m so sorry…”
“Why do you need to apologize? You did nothing wrong.”

Father tilted his head in confusion at Fiancé’s bowing and apologizing. That’s right. Fiancé may be a rival, but she is also someone I acknowledge. There’s no way she would be involved in something like this without reason.
“Mel-chan, Sakura… will be okay…”
Sakura-chan stretched her neck to reassure Fiancé.
“Stay still, Sakura-chan. Your treatment isn’t finished yet.”
“Okay…”
“What exactly happened?”
Yuki-chan asked Father and the others.
“I arrived in the middle of it, so I don’t know everything… but Motoyasu-kun, I ran into someone named Takt.”
What!? To think we’d run into him here—how unfortunate. And to wound Sakura-chan like this…
I had planned to defeat him from the start, but now, even if Father tries to stop me, I will never forgive such a heinous act.
“By the way, Father, this is Fiancé.”
“Someone you knew from a previous loop?”
“Not an enemy, so you can rest easy.”
“I see… So, Mel-chan, right? Can you explain everything from the beginning?”
“Ah, y-yes! Um… It was my fault. I’m so sorry… Actually—”
Fiancé began explaining the situation.
